hook: Your ferry ride in Istanbul crosses two continents.
title: This Ferry Ride Crosses Two Continents
description:
Istanbul is split by the Bosphorus strait, with one side in Europe and the other in Asia. Commuters cross between continents by ferry every day. It is one city on two continents.

#Shorts #Istanbul #Geography
comment_prompt: Europe or Asia side? Pick one
